title: Dinka Music - Melodigging
text: Dinka music is the traditional vocal- and rhythm-centered music of the Dinka (Jieng) people of South Sudan. It is predominantly collective and participatory, built around a lead singer who cues a chorus in call-and-response, supported by handclaps, foot-stomps, ululations, and simple percussion.
